lines.en: label firsttimeshrine:
scene anewbeginning1
I find myself wandering up the stairs to one of the last places I ever expected to be.
lines.zh: 我发现自己正拾级而上，走向一个我从未想过会踏足的地方。

lines.en: I’m sure that doesn’t mean much to you considering we haven’t known each other very long, but it’s the truth.
lines.zh: 我知道，考虑到我们认识的时间还不长，这对你来说没什么意义，但这是事实。

lines.en: I’ve never been a religious person. Or...at least I don’t {i}think{/i} I’ve ever been much of a religious person.
lines.zh: 我从来都不是个有宗教信仰的人。或者……至少我不{i}觉得{/i}自己曾经有多虔诚。

lines.en: Ask me again later and I might have a better answer for you.
lines.zh: 过阵子再问我，也许我能给你一个更好的答案。

lines.en: But for now, I’ll take cover in the shade provided by the clouds within my head and hope to somehow escape this summer heat unscathed.
lines.zh: 但现在，我要躲进脑中云层投下的阴影里，盼着能毫发无伤地逃过这场酷暑。

lines.en: There’s an old saying here where all Japanese are born Shinto and die Buddhist, but just because it’s a commonly used expression doesn’t mean it’s something that applies to all of us.
lines.zh: 这里有句老话：日本人出生时是神道教徒，死去时是佛教徒。可一句常用俗语，不代表它就适用于我们所有人。

lines.en: Some of us are simply born.
lines.zh: 有些人只是出生。

lines.en: Some of us simply die.
lines.zh: 有些人只是死去。

lines.en: Some of us get lost somewhere in between those two things.
lines.zh: 有些人在这两者之间的某处迷失。

lines.en: And some of us are lucky enough to wake up in an alternate reality based on sheer luck and no influence from any god whatsoever.
lines.zh: 而有些人足够幸运，纯粹靠着运气、在没有任何神明插手的情况下，于另一个现实中醒来。

lines.en: I’ll throw myself into that category as it keeps me out of debt with any higher power...and I’ll tell myself that the reason I am standing here right now is not because I am seeking salvation.
lines.zh: 我就把自己归进这一类好了，这样我就不用欠任何更高存在的债……我也会告诉自己，我此刻站在这里，并不是在寻求救赎。

lines.en: It is not because I am lost.
lines.zh: 不是因为我迷失了方向。

lines.en: It is because I wanted to spit in God’s face.
lines.zh: 而是因为我想往上帝的脸上啐一口唾沫。

lines.en: I contort my mouth into a grotesque shape and allow saliva to pool up inside of my cheeks, but wind up swallowing it all down when a soft set of footsteps head my way to break me out of my daydreaming.
lines.zh: 我把嘴扭曲成一个怪异的形状，让口水在腮帮子里积起来——可当一阵轻柔的脚步声朝我走来、把我从白日梦里拽出来时，我还是把口水全咽了下去。

lines.en: : Oh...wonderful.
lines.zh: : 哦……真棒。

lines.en: : Getting started early this time, I see.
lines.zh: : 看来这次开始得挺早啊。

lines.en: scene anewbeginning2
: And here I was thinking I’d be able to make it at least the first weekend without you showing up and ruining my day.
lines.zh: : 我还以为至少第一个周末，你不会冒出来毁掉我这一天呢。

lines.en: : I’m sorry?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : It’s nothing. Just...complaining to myself.
lines.zh: : 没什么。只是……在跟自己抱怨。

lines.en: : Well, feel free to complain to me if you like. We’ve known each other long enough that-
lines.zh: : 那你想抱怨的话尽管跟我说。我们都认识这么久了——

lines.en: scene anewbeginning3
: Oh, give me a break. We both know you’re not who you say you are.
lines.zh: : 哦，得了吧。我们俩都心知肚明，你根本不是你自称的那个人。

lines.en: : I...have no idea what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 我……完全不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: : Oh? So you {i}didn’t{/i} just happen to wake up inside of that body and assume the role of someone entirely unfamiliar to you?
lines.zh: : 哦？那你{i}不是{/i}碰巧在那具身体里醒来，然后扮演起一个你完全陌生的人？

lines.en: How...does she know that?
lines.zh: 她……是怎么知道的？

lines.en: This has to be some sort of trap, right?
lines.zh: 这肯定是某种圈套，对吧？

lines.en: If my own niece wasn’t able to pick up on me taking over, why would one of her friends be able to?
lines.zh: 如果连我自己的侄女都没察觉到我接管了这具身体，她的一个朋友又怎么会察觉？

lines.en: : Nope. In fact, that sounds pretty ridiculous.
lines.zh: : 不是。事实上，这听起来相当荒谬。

lines.en: scene anewbeginning4
: It does, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 是挺荒谬的，对吧？

lines.en: : Allow me to clue you in on something if you’re going to continue being so determined to walk a mile in someone else’s shoes.
lines.zh: : 既然你这么执意要穿着别人的鞋走下去，那就让我给你提个醒。

lines.en: : The {i}real{/i} you would have never come to a place like this. So, if you’re going to be that dedicated to playing the part, you should probably just leave now before someone else sees you here.
lines.zh: : {i}真正{/i}的你绝不会来这种地方。所以，如果你真这么投入地演这个角色，趁现在还没有别人看见你，最好赶紧走人。

lines.en: Well, at least that’s one thing the previous inhabitant of this body and I have in common.
lines.zh: 嗯，至少在这一点上，这具身体的前任主人和我还算有共同之处。

lines.en: I say, despite acting out of my own character and deciding to come here anyway for no reason whatsoever.
lines.zh: 我这么想着——尽管我完全是反着自己的性子，毫无理由地决定还是要来这里。

lines.en: : You’re really just...not going to believe me, are you?
lines.zh: : 你真的……就是不肯相信我，是吗？

lines.en: : Sorry. I normally have to get to know someone a little better before I start trusting them like that.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我通常得先跟一个人熟络一些，才会那样信任他。

lines.en: : Unfortunately for you, you’re one of the last people I’d ever go out of my way to do that with.
lines.zh: : 对你来说不幸的是，你是我最不愿意特地这么去做的那类人之一。

lines.en: : So again, quit while you’re ahead and leave. You’ll be saving both of us a great deal of energy.
lines.zh: : 所以再说一次：见好就收，走吧。这样能替我们俩省下大把精力。

lines.en: : Just out of curiosity, are you always this confrontational with me?
lines.zh: : 只是好奇问一句，你对我总是这么针锋相对吗？

lines.en: : Yes. Yes, I am.
lines.zh: : 是。是的，我就是。

lines.en: : But isn’t that something you would already know if you really were {i}you?{/i}
lines.zh: : 可如果你真的是你，这种事{i}你{/i}不是早该知道了吗？

lines.en: : Didn’t Ami tell you the other day? I’ve been having-
lines.zh: : Ami 那天没告诉你吗？我一直——

lines.en: scene anewbeginning5
: Memory problems? Is that really the best that all of you can come up with?
lines.zh: : 失忆？这真的是你们所有人能想出来的最好借口吗？

lines.en: : Just once, I’d like to hear a new excuse and not the same...default answer I always get.
lines.zh: : 哪怕就一次，我也想听个新借口，而不是每次都得到同一套……默认答案。

lines.en: : For the last time, I’m-
lines.zh: : 最后说一次，我是——

lines.en: scene anewbeginning6
: If you’re the real Sensei, what’s Ami’s birthday? Here, I’ll even give you a hint. It’s sometime in August.
lines.zh: : 如果你是真的 Sensei，那 Ami 的生日是几号？来，我甚至给你个提示。在八月。

lines.en: : What’s wrong? Have you really forgotten your own niece’s birthday?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？你真的连自己侄女的生日都忘了？

lines.en: : August...
lines.zh: : 八月……

lines.en: : Seventh?
lines.zh: : 七号？

lines.en: scene anewbeginning7
: Hah...
Fuck.
lines.zh: 操。

lines.en: : Just as I thought. And I even gave you a hint this time and everything.
lines.zh: : 果然不出我所料。而且这次我还给了你提示什么的。

lines.en: : Though...I guess I have no idea if the {i}real{/i} you would have even remembered that answer in the first place. That was just the type of guy he was.
lines.zh: : 不过……我大概也不知道，{i}真正{/i}的你到底会不会记得那个答案。他就是那种人。

lines.en: : Just the type of guy I {i}am,{/i} you mean.
lines.zh: : 你是说，我{i}就是{/i}那种人。

lines.en: scene anewbeginning8
: Seriously? You’re going to keep the charade up even though I’ve already caught you in like, three different ways so far? How stupid are you?
lines.zh: : 说真的？我都已经从三种不同的角度抓到你的破绽了，你还打算继续演下去？你到底有多蠢？

lines.en: : Correct me if I’m wrong, but I don’t think shrine maidens are really supposed to be talking to people that way.
lines.zh: : 如果我错了请纠正我，不过我觉得巫女不该那样跟人说话吧。

lines.en: scene anewbeginning9
: Fine. I will. You are wrong and this is me correcting you.
lines.zh: : 好。那我就纠正你。你错了，这就是我在纠正你。

lines.en: : Do you feel like an idiot yet? Are you embarrassed at how easily I managed to see through your act?
lines.zh: : 你现在觉得自己像个白痴了吗？我这么轻易就看穿了你的把戏，你害臊吗？

lines.en: : Are {i}you{/i} embarrassed wearing that dress?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}穿着那身衣服不害臊吗？

lines.en: : Why would I be embarrassed? I am fucking adorable.
lines.zh: : 我为什么要害臊？我他妈可爱死了。

lines.en: : I don’t think shrine maidens are supposed to say “fucking adorable” either.
lines.zh: : 我觉得巫女也不该说“他妈可爱死了”。

lines.en: : You sure seem to know a lot about shrine maidens for someone who has yet to even pray.
lines.zh: : 一个连祈祷都还没做的人，对巫女的事懂得倒挺多。

lines.en: : Is your affinity for girls who dress like me the reason you came here first this time?
lines.zh: : 你这次先来这里，是因为你对穿成我这样的女孩有特殊偏好？

lines.en: : Am I just fetish material for you? Are you that unabashedly perverted?
lines.zh: : 我在你眼里只是个性癖对象吗？你就那么恬不知耻地变态？

lines.en: : No, I just...didn’t really have a choice, I think.
lines.zh: : 不，我只是……我想，我其实没什么选择。

lines.en: scene anewbeginning10
: You...didn’t have a choice? What is that supposed to mean?
lines.zh: : 你……没什么选择？这话什么意思？

lines.en: : After talking to Ami, I left the house. Then...before I knew it, I was walking up the steps and monologuing about the whole “Born Shinto, Die Buddhist” thing.
lines.zh: : 跟 Ami 谈完之后，我出了门。然后……不知不觉间，我就已经在拾级而上，还在心里独白那一套“生为神道，死为佛教”的东西。

lines.en: : Oh, is {i}that{/i} why you looked so pathetic on your way up the stairs? I had just assumed it was because you’re getting too old to walk anymore.
lines.zh: : 哦，{i}所以{/i}你上台阶时才一副惨兮兮的样子？我还以为是你老得走不动路了呢。

lines.en: : Come on. I’m not that old, am I?
lines.zh: : 拜托。我没那么老吧？

lines.en: : You tell me. At the very least, you should remember your age. Right?
lines.zh: : 你告诉我啊。至少，你总该记得自己的年纪吧？

lines.en: The longer this conversation carries on, the further Maya manages to press me into a corner.
lines.zh: 这场对话拖得越久，Maya 就越是把我逼进角落。

lines.en: And as much as I want to say I don’t think she’s serious and that this is all just some sort of...vetting process or something, I understand that it’s much more than that.
lines.zh: 尽管我很想说自己觉得她并不是认真的，这一切只是某种……审查流程之类的，可我明白，事情远不止如此。

lines.en: She knows something.
lines.zh: 她知道些什么。

lines.en: Something about {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: 关于{i}我{/i}的某些事。

lines.en: Something about how I got here or...where we are or...any of the things Ami wasn’t able to fill me in on during our talk earlier.
lines.zh: 关于我是怎么来到这里的，或者……我们究竟身在何处，又或者……刚才那场谈话里 Ami 没能告诉我的任何一件事。

lines.en: But-
lines.zh: 可是——

lines.en: For some reason...
lines.zh: 不知为何……

lines.en: I can’t bring myself to admit that she’s right out loud.
lines.zh: 我没办法开口承认她是对的。

lines.en: And so I do what I imagine I always did in my previous life.
lines.zh: 于是我做了我想象中自己前世一贯会做的事。

lines.en: I lie through my teeth in hopes of persuading her.
lines.zh: 我睁着眼睛说瞎话，希望能说服她。

lines.en: : You’re wrong about me, you know.
lines.zh: : 你对我判断错了，你知道吗。

lines.en: : No, I’m not.
lines.zh: : 不，我没有。

lines.en: As you can see, it doesn’t work.
lines.zh: 如你所见，这招没用。

lines.en: scene anewbeginning11
: So...this monologue you speak of...exactly what did it entail?
lines.zh: : 那么……你说的那段独白……具体都讲了些什么？

lines.en: : Oh? Are you actually interested in something I have to say now? Or are you just going to use this opportunity to mock me a little more?
lines.zh: : 哦？你现在真的开始对我说的东西感兴趣了？还是说你只是想借这个机会再多嘲讽我几句？

lines.en: : I guess it really depends on your answer. I’m not particularly fond of religion, but I’d be lying if I said it didn’t interest me in...some form.
lines.zh: : 我想这得看你的回答。我算不上特别喜欢宗教，但如果我说自己对它毫无兴趣……那是在撒谎，起码在某种形式上有兴趣。

lines.en: : You’re really just full of anti-miko jargon, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你满嘴都是反巫女的行话，是吧？

lines.en: : I’m perhaps the world’s worst {i}and{/i} best shrine maiden all at once. Though, I imagine anyone actually good at this wouldn’t really understand what I consider my strong points.
lines.zh: : 我大概同时是全世界最差、{i}也是{/i}最好的巫女。不过我想，真正擅长这行的人，大概也不会理解我所认为的自己的优点。

lines.en: : Well, the monologue wasn’t all that interesting. It was moreso just an excuse for me to be fatalistic on the way up the stairs, I think.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那段独白没那么有意思。与其说是什么了不起的东西，不如说是我在上台阶时给自己找了个宿命论的借口。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 这样啊。

lines.en: scene anewbeginning10
: Well, you’re right about it not being interesting if that’s really all it was. So allow me to use this opportunity to tell you more about what {i}I{/i} think.
lines.zh: : 嗯，如果真的只是那样，那它确实没什么意思。那就容我借这个机会，跟你多说说{i}我{/i}的想法。

lines.en: : Do you have a pen and paper on you? Because this is information that I think you’ll want to keep in mind if you really do want to succeed in this world.
lines.zh: : 你身上带纸笔了吗？因为如果你真想在这个世界里走下去，我觉得你最好把这些话记下来。

lines.en: : {i}Especially{/i} if you have so many alleged memory issues.
lines.zh: : {i}尤其是{/i}你号称有那么严重的失忆问题。

lines.en: : I...don’t really carry that sort of stuff with me.
lines.zh: : 我……身上不太带那种东西。

lines.en: : Aren’t you supposed to be a teacher?
lines.zh: : 你不是当老师的吗？

lines.en: : Just...tell me what you’re trying to tell me, Maya.
lines.zh: : 你就……直接告诉我想说什么吧，Maya。

lines.en: : Okay. But, if you’re anything like the rest of them, you’re not going to remember any of this anyway.
lines.zh: : 好。不过，如果你跟其他那些人一样，反正你也不会记住这些。

lines.en: : Then why bother telling me at all? Since you’re so sure of who I am, I mean.
lines.zh: : 那你又何必跟我说呢？我的意思是，既然你这么确定我是谁。

lines.en: : Because despite my cold demeanor and mostly expressionless face...and the fact that I really just abhor you all around-
lines.zh: : 因为尽管我态度冷淡、几乎面无表情……而且说实话我彻头彻尾地厌恶你——

lines.en: : I want to give you a head start.
lines.zh: : 我还是想让你有个先手优势。

lines.en: : Or a...chance, so to speak.
lines.zh: : 或者说，一个……机会。

lines.en: : It’s the least I can do before permanently severing ties with you.
lines.zh: : 在我跟你彻底断绝关系之前，这算是我能做的最后一点事。

lines.en: : Permanently? Why does it have to be permanent?
lines.zh: : 彻底？为什么非得是彻底？

lines.en: : Because I want absolutely nothing to do with you for reasons I don’t have the time to explain today.
lines.zh: : 因为我根本不想跟你有任何牵扯，至于原因，我今天没时间解释。

lines.en: : If you must, you may speak to me in school. But only when there are others present and only when what you need to speak about pertains to school itself.
lines.zh: : 实在必要的话，你可以在学校跟我说话。但只能在他人在场时，而且只能聊与学校本身有关的事。

lines.en: : Or anything I personally find interesting. But even then, I’d likely rather just think about those things on my own than discuss them with my friend’s grandfather.
lines.zh: : 或者是我个人感兴趣的话题。不过即便如此，我也宁愿自己琢磨，而不是跟我朋友的爷爷讨论。

lines.en: : Uncle.
lines.zh: : 是叔叔。

lines.en: : Great uncle?
lines.zh: : 叔公？

lines.en: : Just uncle...
lines.zh: : 只是叔叔……

lines.en: : Apologies.
lines.zh: : 失敬了。

lines.en: scene anewbeginning12

Maya closes her eyes and smacks her broom against the ground but, since the hard part of it is facing upward, the soft part is the one that makes contact with the concrete and barely makes a noise at all.
lines.zh: Maya 闭上眼睛，把扫帚往地上一拍——可因为硬的那头朝上，接触混凝土地面的是软的那头，几乎没发出一点声音。

lines.en: Needless to say, it was a failed attempt at looking cool and I’m hoping that whatever her speech is about winds up earning her some bonus points in that department.
lines.zh: 不用说，这次耍帅失败了。我只希望她接下来那番话，能替她在这个方面扳回几分。

lines.en: : There is an infinite amount of worlds out there...and an infinite amount of possibilities within each and every one of them.
lines.zh: : 外面有无限多的世界……而每一个世界里，又有无限多的可能性。

lines.en: : And with an infinite amount of people and souls waiting to be recycled, the contents of each one of those worlds are rapidly changing.
lines.zh: : 有无限多的人和灵魂等着被回收，于是每一个世界的内容都在飞速变化。

lines.en: : They spin together, but in different directions.
lines.zh: : 它们一起旋转，却朝着不同的方向。

lines.en: : Sometimes, they spin so fast that parts of them combine.
lines.zh: : 有时它们转得太快，一部分便融合在了一起。

lines.en: : With that in mind, each one of those potential worlds in the never ending, ever expanding list of them is like a cocktail of misfortune and agony with an occasional splash of joy and...mint.
lines.zh: : 这么说来，在那份永无止境、不断膨胀的清单上，每一个可能的世界都像一杯由不幸与痛苦调成的鸡尾酒，偶尔溅入一点喜悦和……薄荷。

lines.en: : Mint?
lines.zh: : 薄荷？

lines.en: : Shut up. I’m not done.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴。我还没说完。

lines.en: Maya slaps the ground with the broom again, but actually looks a little bit cool this time.
lines.zh: Maya 又用扫帚拍了一下地面，不过这次看起来确实有那么点帅。

lines.en: : Somehow or another, despite the endless amount of possibilities and universes overflowing with the opposites of what we desire-
lines.zh: : 不管怎么说，尽管可能性无穷无尽，宇宙里满是我们所渴望之物的反面——

lines.en: : Somehow or another, you wound up here.
lines.zh: : 不管怎么说，你还是来到了这里。

lines.en: : At the same shrine as me.
lines.zh: : 和我同一座神社。

lines.en: : In the same town as me.
lines.zh: : 和我同一座小镇。

lines.en: : Feigning ignorance and pretending that you’ve been here all along is a slap in the face to whatever force or forces brought you before me.
lines.zh: : 你装作一无所知、假装自己一直都在这里，这对那个把你带到我面前的某种或某些力量，是一记响亮的耳光。

lines.en: : If you believe that force to be coincidence, coincidence is God.
lines.zh: : 如果你认为那股力量是巧合，那巧合就是你的上帝。

lines.en: : If you believe it to be some supernatural entity, {i}that{/i} is your God.
lines.zh: : 如果你认为它是某种超自然存在，{i}那{/i}它就是你的上帝。

lines.en: : But no matter what “God” you choose and what story you decide on, you must remember first and foremost...
lines.zh: : 但无论你选择哪个“上帝”、认定哪个故事，你首先必须记住的是……

lines.en: scene anewbeginning13
: That none of that matters at all.
lines.zh: : 那些统统都不重要。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : None of it.
lines.zh: : 一点都不重要。

lines.en: : Then why did you even bother-
lines.zh: : 那你何必还说这些——

lines.en: : Because what matters more than {i}how{/i} you got here is what you are going to do now that you are.
lines.zh: : 因为比起你是{i}怎么{/i}来的，更重要的是你既然已经来了，打算做什么。

lines.en: : Now that you know how the world works, you are free to ignore it...for the most part, at least.
lines.zh: : 既然你已经知道了世界如何运转，就可以……基本上，随你无视它。

lines.en: : {i}What?{/i}
: Somehow or another, you were given a life in the same space as me. At the same time as me.
lines.zh: : 不管怎么说，你得到了一段人生，与我处在同一片空间。与我处在同一个时间。

lines.en: : And you would be an absolute moron to not make the most of it- whether you call that life yours or accept that it belongs to someone else.
lines.zh: : 而你要是不好好把握它，那才是彻头彻尾的蠢货——无论你把这段人生称作自己的，还是承认它属于别人。

lines.en: : But...why are you telling me this when you’ve already come out and admitted to disliking me?
lines.zh: : 可……你都已经明说讨厌我了，为什么还要告诉我这些？

lines.en: : Why help me at all?
lines.zh: : 为什么要帮我？

lines.en: scene anewbeginning14
: The answer to that is one I’ve already alluded to.
lines.zh: : 这个问题的答案，我刚才已经暗示过了。

lines.en: : And it’s because...
lines.zh: : 那就是因为……

lines.en: : From this moment on...
lines.zh: : 从这一刻起……

lines.en: scene anewbeginning15
: You will have nothing to do with me.
lines.zh: : 你与我再无瓜葛。

lines.en: : I don’t care how badly you want to see me. I don’t care if it eats at you from the inside out.
lines.zh: : 我不在乎你有多想见我。我不在乎这件事会不会从里到外把你啃噬殆尽。

lines.en: : You are strictly forbidden from coming here...and you are strictly forbidden from ever even {i}attempting{/i} to get to know me.
lines.zh: : 严禁你再来这里……也严禁你哪怕{i}试着{/i}来了解我。

lines.en: : The reason I was willing to help you out to the extent I have today is that {i}my{/i} existence is heavily dependent on yours.
lines.zh: : 我今天愿意帮你到这个地步，是因为{i}我的{/i}存在严重依赖于你的存在。

lines.en: : And that existence is in grave danger if you do not heed this warning.
lines.zh: : 而如果你不听从这个警告，我的存在就会陷入巨大的危险。

lines.en: : Do I make myself clear?
lines.zh: : 我说得够清楚了吗？

lines.en: : Absolutely.
lines.zh: : 绝对清楚。

lines.en: : So you agree to leave me alone? And to never come here again?
lines.zh: : 所以你同意不打扰我？也同意再也不来这里？

lines.en: : Absolutely not.
lines.zh: : 绝对不同意。

lines.en: scene anewbeginning16
: Hah...
There is no slap of the broom this time- just the resigned sigh of a girl who looks like she’s all out of options.
lines.zh: 这次没有扫帚拍地——只有一个看起来已经无计可施的女孩，发出的一声认命的叹息。

lines.en: : Predictable as ever.
lines.zh: : 一如既往地好猜。

lines.en: : Why is it so important that I stay away from you? And what do you mean when you say that your existence is dependent on mine?
lines.zh: : 为什么我非得离你远一点？你说你的存在依赖于我的存在，到底是什么意思？

lines.en: : What I mean is that I want you to stop looking for answers and just go enjoy your exciting new life surrounded by tons of cute girls not named Maya.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我想让你别再追问答案，去好好享受你那刺激的新生活，身边围着一万个不叫 Maya 的可爱女孩。

lines.en: : But what if I’m only into girls named Maya?
lines.zh: : 可万一我只喜欢叫 Maya 的女孩呢？

lines.en: scene anewbeginning17
: Then I suggest you find another.
lines.zh: : 那我建议你再找一个。

lines.en: : Because getting close to you is the actual worst thing that could possibly happen.
lines.zh: : 因为跟你走近，是可能发生的最糟糕的事。

lines.en: : That’s-
lines.zh: : 那是——

lines.en: : For {i}both{/i} of us. Not just me.
lines.zh: : 对我们{i}两个{/i}都是。不只是我。

lines.en: scene anewbeginning16
: Now, go. I still have work to do around here.
lines.zh: : 好了，走吧。我这儿还有活要干。

lines.en: : And don’t worry about me revealing your big {i}secret{/i} to any of the other girls. It’s not like they’d even believe me if I told them anyway.
lines.zh: : 也别担心我会把你的大{i}秘密{/i}说给其他女孩听。反正就算我说了，她们也不会信。

lines.en: : Why have you not left yet?
lines.zh: : 你怎么还不走？

lines.en: : I just figured I’d say thank you first.
lines.zh: : 我只是想先说声谢谢。

lines.en: scene anewbeginning13
: Oh?
: Especially since I can’t make good on that whole “leaving you alone” thing.
lines.zh: : 尤其是因为我大概做不到“不打扰你”这件事。

lines.en: : So you intend to drag the two of us into ruin together? Is that really what you want?
lines.zh: : 所以你打算把我们俩一起拖进毁灭？这真的是你想要的吗？

lines.en: : I have no idea what I want.
lines.zh: : 我不知道自己想要什么。

lines.en: : I just know that leaving you out of it won’t be part of the plan.
lines.zh: : 我只知道，把你排除在外，不在我的计划之内。

lines.en: scene anewbeginning14
: You’re disgusting. Please leave me alone forever.
lines.zh: : 你真恶心。请你永远别来烦我。

lines.en: : I’ll leave you alone {i}for now{/i}.
lines.zh: : 我{i}现在先{/i}不烦你。

lines.en: : But I’ll be back soon.
lines.zh: : 但我很快就会回来。

lines.en: : Then I suppose I’ll begin looking for hiding places as soon as you leave. I appreciate you for giving me a heads up.
lines.zh: : 那么等你一走，我想我就该开始找藏身之处了。谢谢你提前给我打个招呼。

lines.en: : Same here. Just...with the whole parallel universes thing and not the hiding thing. Even if I...barely understood any of what you were talking about.
lines.zh: : 彼此彼此。只不过……我说的是平行宇宙那套，不是藏身那件事。虽然我……几乎没听懂你说的任何一个字。

lines.en: : I knew that you wouldn’t. Your brain is too smooth and full of sexual fantasies involving your niece and her friends.
lines.zh: : 我就知道你听不懂。你的脑子太光滑了，装满了关于你侄女和她朋友们的性幻想。

lines.en: : You know you’re one of those friends, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道你自己就是那些朋友之一吧？

lines.en: : Please don’t ruin my lunch for me before I’ve even had a chance to eat it...
lines.zh: : 求你别在我还没来得及吃之前，就把我的午饭给毁了……

lines.en: scene black
So...
lines.zh: 那么……

lines.en: That’s Maya, I guess.
lines.zh: 这就是 Maya 了吧，我想。

lines.en: She’s a little...different from how I expected her to be.
lines.zh: 她跟我想象中的……有点不一样。

lines.en: Granted, I wasn’t really sure what {i}to{/i} expect since every interaction I’ve had with her up until now has been extremely brief, but...
lines.zh: 当然，我也说不准自己原本{i}期待{/i}什么，毕竟到目前为止我跟她的每一次接触都极其短暂，不过……

lines.en: Having her...aware of my existence when no one else is?
lines.zh: 让她……在别人都毫无察觉的情况下，知道我的存在？

lines.en: How is that even possible?
lines.zh: 这怎么可能？

lines.en: And how can she expect me to just leave her alone after {i}revealing{/i} that she knows all of that?
lines.zh: 她都{i}摊牌{/i}说自己知道这一切了，又怎么能指望我就这么离她远点？

lines.en: Of course I’m going to keep coming back to her when she’s presenting an entire platter worth of reasons to do that right in front of my face.
lines.zh: 她把一整盘理由就这么端在我面前，我当然会不断回来找她。

lines.en: I just...
lines.zh: 我只是……

lines.en: I have no idea where to start when I do.
lines.zh: 只是不知道到时候该从哪儿下手。

lines.en: Everything on the platter is something I’ve never seen before.
lines.zh: 那盘上的每一样东西，都是我从未见过的。

lines.en: But, I guess that’s how {i}everything{/i} is for me now.
lines.zh: 不过，我想现在的{i}一切{/i}对我来说都是这样吧。

lines.en: This life. This town.
lines.zh: 这段人生。这座小镇。

lines.en: It’s all one big platter full of beautiful, new things.
lines.zh: 它们就是一大盘盛满美好而新鲜事物的东西。

lines.en: And I can’t wait to get my hands on all of them.
lines.zh: 而我迫不及待想把每一样都拿到手。
